scope: registered roof correction and two forest-side detail images

prompts.prompt: Precise geometry repair of an aerial map. INPUT1 is the photographic terrain to edit. INPUT2 is a REGISTRATION GUIDE of exactly the same frame: the 86 CYAN quadrilateral outlines are the REQUIRED individual roof footprints, and GOLD thin lines are required road centerlines. Correct the roof corners and centroids in INPUT1 to coincide with each cyan quadrilateral from INPUT2; remove displaced roof remnants and repair surrounding ground naturally. There must be exactly one roof inside every cyan quadrilateral, same shape, orientation, exact size, no additional roofs. Correct only the small road displacements so their centerlines follow the gold guide; keep naturally irregular worn edges. DO NOT render any cyan/gold lines, annotations or symbols in the output. Preserve all other scene content, river banks, stream, pier, bridges, field boundaries and all four edges. Retain photographic texture with individually weathered slate and timber roofs, organic gardens, fine mixed canopy and understated olive gray colors. Strict vertical nadir, no new structures, no miniature perspective. Keep input1's entire frame and 11:7 landscape aspect ratio. Crisp native detail, exact placement more important than invented embellishment.

Create a sharp detailed photographic repair of INPUT1, the WEST adjoining Veles forest sector. INPUT2 is its exact geographic layout, not a style reference. Region size is 1200m wide x1400m tall, portrait6:7. In INPUT1 the narrow RIGHT part is already finely detailed forest, while the rest is blurry and has oversized tree crowns. Extend the fine realistic forest treatment uniformly across the whole image: natural overlapping irregular mixed broadleaf/conifer crowns 8-18m across, varied ages/density, low understory and small patchy clearings. KEEP the rightmost 20 percent visually and spatially compatible with the existing sharp forest (same crown scale, muted olive colors and light). Preserve the exact path from top near x85% to right near y70%, all frame edge crossings, the tiny field patch at bottom right and low-relief terrain. Do not invent houses, major clearings, rivers, paths, mountains or giant trees. This is a strict vertical aerial orthophoto, no sides or miniature diorama. Fine natural terrain, no stamps, tiled pattern or blur. Do not add text, UI or labels. Preserve framing and geography, sharpen by creating actual natural detail, not over-sharpening halos.

Photographic high-detail repair of INPUT1, EAST adjoining forest and river sector. INPUT2 is the exact geometry guide ONLY. Region is 1200m wide x1400m tall, portrait6:7. Input1 contains a sharp narrow forest strip on LEFT and blurry giant-crown vegetation elsewhere. Continue the LEFT strip's realistic fine photographic canopy scale, detail, light and olive colors seamlessly across the entire map. Tree crowns must be 8-18m diameter, NOT giant 50m trees; organic mixed forest with overlapping irregular crowns, undergrowth, subtle gaps. Fix the river banks to match INPUT2 exactly, including centerline, width and top/bottom/left boundary crossings, while rendering realistic dark teal water and weathered river stones at existing banks. Preserve ALL footpaths entering along LEFT and rocky ridge at upper left. No new roads, islands, settlements, clearings, mountains or water branches. Preserve framing and every feature's position. Strict vertical nadir aerial photograph, no tree trunks or facades, no miniature/game sprite look, no repeated stamps or artificial tile boundaries, no UI/text. Actual crisp native terrain detail without sharpening halos.
